name: Spotify
description: Spotify sells monthly music, podcast and audiobook subscriptions (Premium: 300 million subscribers) and runs a free ad-supported tier to feed the paid one, with 777 million monthly users in total. 90.7 percent of revenue is Premium subscriptions and 9.3 percent is advertising. The largest cost is royalties paid to record labels and publishers, so profit depends on gross margin, which reached a record 33.4 percent in Q2 2026 (Premium 34.9 percent), helped by price increases and the mix of new services. Growth levers are price rises, extra tiers (audiobooks, personal AI podcasts, ticketing with Live Nation) and advertising, which grew only 1 percent in Q2 2026.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label from general knowledge; not checked against an MSCI/S&P source. Reports in euros.

hq.note: Registered in Luxembourg (S.A. legal form); operations centred in Stockholm. From general knowledge, not re-read from the 20-F.

businessLines.name: Premium
businessLines.how: Monthly subscriptions paid by 300M subscribers (about 4.89 euros average revenue per user per month, +7% on price rises), with royalties paid to rights holders as the main cost. Segment gross margin 34.9 percent in Q2 2026.
businessLines.marketShare: 31.4% of global paid music streaming subscribers (289.4M) (2025)

businessLines.name: Ad-Supported
businessLines.how: Advertisers pay for audio and video ads and podcast sponsorships shown to free-tier users; also the funnel that converts users to Premium.

brands.name: Spotify (music, podcasts, audiobooks)
brands.share: All revenue; no separate subsidiaries broken out in the release read
